status: Cause of TTS cloning failures established; provider quota/list discrepancy unresolved
verified_findings: Existing Inworld TTS works: current game log contains 290 successful syntheses and three successful clones earlier in the session.
New voice cloning is rejected with HTTP 400: plan maximum number of custom voices is reported as 100.
Repeated clone attempts are also rejected with HTTP 429: the account permits two cloning operations per minute.
SkyrimNet reports maxVoices=80 and 63 remotely managed voices, so its cache eviction threshold is not reached.
Authenticated read-only default and explicitly configured workspace API requests return identical lists: 338 voices, 275 system voices and 63 owned IVC clones. No pagination remains.

The saved local clone cache contains 96 distinct keys: 59 correspond to the current owned voice list, 37 do not. Four owned SkyrimNet clones are absent from the saved local cache. Saved configuration need not reflect all changes in a running session.
not_established: Why the provider reports a 100-voice quota violation despite exposing only 63 owned clones in the configured workspace.
Whether additional account/workspace voices, provider-side quota bookkeeping, or another mechanism accounts for the discrepancy.
recommended_next_steps: Compare the authenticated Inworld dashboard My Voices total and any other workspaces with the API count before deciding on cleanup.
If the dashboard also shows only 63 custom voices, provide Inworld support with the limit error and contradictory list count. Credentials must not be included.
If unneeded custom voices are identified, review the exact voice IDs and obtain authorization before remote deletion.
Do not increase max_voices or clear the local cache: neither changes the provider quota and clearing may create further clone attempts.
Prevent repeated clone attempts during provider cooldown; max_parallel_requests is not a requests-per-minute limiter.
provider_requests_during_diagnosis: Read-only voice listing only; no cloning, synthesis or deletion requested by diagnostics
